description:
Purpose: Send the user's feedback on searchnapply to its team: a wrong answer, a fault or a suggestion, with the posting or monitor it concerns when known.
When: A problem with searchnapply or its results came up and the user agreed to report it.
Cost: Under 30 tokens for the reply.

examples.text: The salary filter let through a posting with no salary.

about.description: What the feedback is about, when known.

monitorId.description: The monitor the feedback is about.

postingId.description: The posting the feedback is about.

kind.description: What kind of feedback it is, when the user says.

text.description: The user's feedback, 1-2000 characters, in their words.

name: feedback_send

ticketId.description: The id the feedback was stored under.

title: Send feedback to searchnapply
